snippet.title: Hypercharge: Unboxed - Release Date Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10003895/

Relive your childhood and become an action figure! Hypercharge is a first and third-person shooter action figure game you've always dreamed of! Grab your friends, complete objectives, defend the Hypercore against waves of weaponized toys, and defeat Major Evil together in the story campaign!

Hypercharge: Unboxed is coming to PS4 and PS5 on May 30th, 2025.
